stations.title: Sunniva
stations.say: Can I sign in with my own email?
stations.note: The old site told on people.

stations.title: The API
stations.text: Keeps a hash for each of the staff.
stations.note: But has no way to sign in.

captions: Sunniva wants to sign in at the front desk with her own email and password.
Today the API keeps her hash but has no way to sign in, so only the shared key works.
You write the sign-in check, its route and its log lines, in three tasks.
Now Sunniva signs in, and a wrong email gets the same answer as a wrong password.
A stranger learns nothing from a refusal, and no secret ever reaches the log.
